digest.component_or_area: autodeploy orchestration and LLM review gate
propositions: Autodeploy recreates the review-bot container without draining in-flight reviews, killing code reviews mid-execution when main advances and bot source changes.

During landing bursts with gaps shorter than a typical ~10 minute review duration, the reconciler's retry path gets killed repeatedly, creating a live-lock where no change receives an LLM-Review vote despite all health signals reading green.

The bot already drains webhook-queued reviews on shutdown, but the reconciler's inline review_and_vote call outside the queue is unprotected and cancelled within 10 seconds, making the self-heal path the vulnerable one.

Autodeploy now defers recreation when in-flight reviews are detected, bounded by DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX=1800s (1.5x the review timeout), with the bound keyed to the deferral episode to prevent timer reset during bursts.

New observability metrics AUTODEPLOY_DEFERRED and AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT with a paging alarm distinguish routine deferrals from timeout/signal-unavailable interrupts to surface previously-blind live-lock scenarios.
